title: Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown
shortDescription: Immortal warrior Sargon explores cursed Mount Qaf utilizing temporal powers and the Memory Shard photo pin system.
historicalSignificance: Heralded as one of the greatest Metroidvanias of the modern era, pairing razor-sharp combat with innovative accessibility.
